claims.text: USGS recorded a magnitude 7.4 earthquake on 10 August 2026 at 12:34:28 UTC, located 5 km S of San José del Palmar, Colombia (4.8436°N, -76.2422°W) at a depth of 110.3 km. USGS's PAGER system assessed an Orange alert level, with approximately 10.5 million people exposed to Strong-to-Very-Strong (MMI VI+) shaking.

GDACS's earthquake report for this event (event id 1557236, episode 1724218) assesses an Overall Orange alert for medium humanitarian impact, with a GDACS score of 1.7 and about 1.5 million people within zones of MMI VII or greater shaking. Citing media reports, the page states at least 132 deaths and more than 570 injuries had been recorded as of 11 August 2026, with the toll expected to rise; UNITAR-UNOSAT had activated satellite-based damage assessment for the affected area.

description: A magnitude 7.4 intermediate-depth earthquake struck western Colombia on 10 August 2026 at 12:34:28 UTC, centered 5 km S of San José del Palmar in Chocó Department, about 240 km west of Bogotá, at a depth of roughly 110 km. USGS's PAGER system assessed an Orange alert level, with an estimated 10.5 million people exposed to strong-to-very-strong shaking (MMI VI+). GDACS separately assessed the event as an Orange alert for medium humanitarian impact, with about 1.5 million people in zones of MMI VII or greater shaking, and its report page cites media accounts of at least 132 deaths and more than 570 injuries as of 11 August 2026, with the toll expected to rise as search-and-rescue efforts continue in the rural, largely road-inaccessible Chocó region. Colombian news media reported that President Abelardo De la Espriella declared a state of national disaster to mobilize additional resources to the worst-affected departments (Chocó, Valle del Cauca, Caldas and Antioquia); this declaration has not yet been confirmed by an allowlisted authoritative source.

impact.summary: GDACS's report page for this event cites media accounts of at least 132 deaths and more than 570 injuries as of 11 August 2026, one day after the earthquake struck. USGS's PAGER system assessed an Orange alert (high likelihood of significant casualties/damage) with about 10.5 million people exposed to strong-to-very-strong shaking; GDACS's own Orange-alert assessment found about 1.5 million people within zones of MMI VII+ shaking. No confirmed displacement figure has yet been published on an allowlisted source. No allowlisted source has yet confirmed the reported national-disaster declaration.

location.region: Chocó Department, near San José del Palmar; strong shaking also felt in Valle del Cauca, Caldas, Antioquia and Bogotá

name: M7.4 Earthquake, Chocó, Colombia
